name: Dumbbell Floor Fly
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with knees bent and feet planted flat.
Hold two dumbbells above your chest with palms facing each other and elbows softly bent.
Open your arms in wide arcs until the backs of your upper arms lightly touch the floor.
Sweep both dumbbells back together above your chest along the same arc.
tips: Touch down gently without bouncing or resting your weight on your elbows.
Maintain a fixed bend in your elbows so the movement stays a fly rather than a press.
